hero.mission1: We're building an app that supports your training. You'll set a plan and log sessions, rest days and niggles. Unsure whether to add load, or something started pulling in a finger and you're wondering if you should back off? Sloper, the AI assistant, will suggest what to do and when it's better to check in with a specialist.

plans.title: Simple plans
plans.description: You'll build a climbing plan and supplemental training. If you don't have a plan yet, we'll make one for you.

load.title: Load under control
load.description: See what the loads were. See your progress. Small niggles don't disappear into the chat.

share.title: Coach, physio and friends in the loop
share.description: Share selected logs with the people who help you train. You choose who sees what.

tests.title: Tests that set the pace
tests.description: Short tests so you can fit load accurately and move forward faster.
